title: A morphism between integral schemes of equal dimension is either non dominant or dominant with finite function field extension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism between integral schemes of equal relative dimension is either not dominant or dominant with finite extension of function fields (statement lines 1815-1824, tag 02QF-adjacent). The proof splits on whether the closure of the image is the whole target, uses dominance to identify the images of the generic points, and converts the equality of the dimension function values into the statement that the extension of function fields has transcendence degree zero, hence is finite. The identification of the generic points is the substance, so the claim is H2.
